name: Mascarpone
siboNotes: Mascarpone is naturally very low in lactose due to its high fat content and minimal processing with cultures, making it well-tolerated for most SIBO patients.
preparationTips: Use at room temperature for easier mixing and spreading
Fold gently into desserts to maintain light texture
Store covered in refrigerator and use within 3-5 days of opening
Can be whipped with low-FODMAP sweeteners for dessert toppings
